line.comment: * Mayhem.SelectNewLeader Gets ship with the most HULL. It does not assign a new leader.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Group reformation is handled by Mayhem.Merc.ReformGroup.
* Group membership is globally tracked through mayhem_mercGroups.
* A null ID means this is a newly created physical group.
* If this ship is being moved from another group, remove its stale membership.
* Initialize complete group and contract state.
* Store our own clean member array rather than the caller's working array.
* Stop any former follower watchdog if this ship was promoted.
